text: 11月12日，商务部新闻发言人何亚东在例行新闻发布会上表示，日前举办的中欧医疗器械专场贸易对接会是中欧贸易投资磋商机制第二次例会一项重要的成果共识。商务部会同财政部、国家卫健委等部门组织160多家国内医疗机构和企业参与市场化采购，欧方组织40多家医疗器械企业参会，双方达成合作意向超过100项。（证券时报）
text_en: On November 12, Ministry of Commerce spokesperson He Yadong said at a regular press conference that the recently held China-EU medical devices trade matchmaking meeting was an important outcome and consensus of the second regular meeting of the China-EU trade and investment consultation mechanism. The Ministry of Commerce, together with the Ministry of Finance, the National Health Commission and other departments, organized more than 160 domestic medical institutions and enterprises to participate in market-based procurement, while the EU side organized more than 40 medical device enterprises to attend, and the two sides reached more than 100 cooperation intentions. (Securities Times)
